# judo-meta-jsl

> JSL (JUDO Specification Language) is an XText-based domain-specific language for defining data models, business logic, and UI specifications on the JUDO platform. This repository provides the full language toolchain, Eclipse IDE integration, LSP servers, and a Handlebars-based code generator.

Key facts:
- Java 21, built with Maven 3.9.4 and Tycho 4.0.13 (Maven-Eclipse bridge)
- Multi-module project with 15 modules spanning standard Maven and Eclipse/Tycho packaging
- XText 2.39.0 language framework with EMF metamodel, Xtend for scoping/validation/formatting
- Handlebars template engine with Spring SpEL for code generation
- Eclipse IDE plugin, standalone LSP fat JAR, and web-based Monaco editor with WebSocket LSP
- OSGi bundle packaging for Apache Karaf deployment
- Licensed under Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Modules — Core Language

- [model/pom.xml](model/pom.xml): XText grammar definition (JslDsl.xtext), scoping providers, validator (~99KB), formatting rules, error messages, and runtime support
- [model-test/pom.xml](model-test/pom.xml): JUnit 5 tests for parsing and model loading using XText testing framework

## Modules — Code Generation

- [generator-engine/pom.xml](generator-engine/pom.xml): Handlebars template-based code generation engine with YAML descriptors and parallel processing support
- [generator-maven-plugin/pom.xml](generator-maven-plugin/pom.xml): Maven plugin wrapping the generator engine with layered template URIs and annotation scanning
- [generator-maven-plugin-test/pom.xml](generator-maven-plugin-test/pom.xml): Integration tests for the generator Maven plugin

## Modules — Eclipse IDE

- [ide/ide-common/pom.xml](ide/ide-common/pom.xml): Content assist proposals and shared IDE functionality
- [ide/ui/pom.xml](ide/ui/pom.xml): Eclipse editor plugin with syntax highlighting
- [ide/preview-plantuml/pom.xml](ide/preview-plantuml/pom.xml): PlantUML diagram generation from JSL models
- [ide/feature/pom.xml](ide/feature/pom.xml): Packages IDE plugins as an installable Eclipse feature

## Modules — LSP Servers

- [server-embedded/pom.xml](server-embedded/pom.xml): Standalone LSP server as a fat JAR via Maven Shade
- [server-web/pom.xml](server-web/pom.xml): WebSocket LSP server with Monaco editor frontend

## Modules — OSGi & Distribution

- [osgi/pom.xml](osgi/pom.xml): Repackages model for OSGi containers with bundle tracking
- [osgi-itest/pom.xml](osgi-itest/pom.xml): Karaf-based OSGi integration smoke tests using Pax Exam
- [feature/feature.xml](feature/feature.xml): Eclipse feature repository
- [site/pom.xml](site/pom.xml): Eclipse P2 update site with version-specific URLs

## Depends on

- [judo-generator-commons](../../runtime/judo-generator-commons): Handlebars template-based code generation framework
- [osgi-utils](../../runtime/osgi-utils): OSGi utility library — lifecycle tracking, config monitoring, ranked services
- [judo-requirement-report](../../tools/judo-requirement-report): Annotation processor generating CSV requirement traceability reports

## Used by

- [community-documentation](../../community-documentation): Community-facing JUDO platform documentation
- [documentation](../../documentation): JUDO platform documentation
- [judo-tatami-jsl](../../runtime/judo-tatami-jsl): JSL-to-runtime model transformation engine (PSM, ASM, UI, RDBMS, etc.)
- [judo-tatami-jsl-tests](../../runtime/judo-tatami-jsl-tests): Full-stack test application generation from JSL model definitions
- [judo-spring-maven-plugin](../../spring/judo-spring-maven-plugin): Maven plugin transforming JSL models into Spring Boot application code
- [judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template](../../template/judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template): Project template generator for fullstack Karaf-based JUDO applications
- [judo-jsl-vscode](../../tools/judo-jsl-vscode): VS Code extension for JSL with embedded Java language server
